label: pjm 53 zonal gas (keeper)
definition: (PJM KEEPER -- most structurally faithful PJM run to date, rule #1; supersedes pjm-48) pjm-52 coal-bit sticky stack base (verbatim) + the new structural lever pjm_zonal_gas_basis. The lever shifts each PJM gas unit by its zone's MEASURED EIA delivered-to-electric-power gas basis vs Henry Hub (series N3045<ST>3M by the zone's primary state -- IL/OH/OH/WV/PA/VA/NJ/MD for ComEd/AEP_Ohio/ATSI/West_APS/Central_PA/Dominion/EMAAC/SWMAAC; data/raw/pjm_zonal_gas_hub.csv), a forward-reproducible measured power-plant delivered cost, anchored to a gas-capacity-weighted mean of ZERO so the calibrated PJM fleet-aggregate gas level is byte-preserved (forecasts stay byte-safe; coal-sigmoid reference left on the ISO mean). This is the correct PJM gas market structure -- PJM zones genuinely buy gas off different regional hubs (west coal belt cheap, EMAAC/SWMAAC/Dominion dear) -- and replaces the single ISO-wide gas series with measured per-zone data (rules #1, #12). KEEPER on STRUCTURAL FAITHFULNESS, not on fit: the determination is still NOT-YET. OPEN MISS (honest): the lever is currently INERT -- the zonal LMP spread is $0.00 in all 8760 hours of all three years (perfect copper-plate) and the dispatch is unchanged (2024 COAL_BIT 97.2 vs 96.6, net export +61.0 vs +63.0; gas-CC still +11.3/+17.2/+16.9% over, COAL_BIT -15.4/-13.0/-3.3% under, LMP -3.9/-10.4/-14.4% under, interchange +49.3/+61.0/+57.8 vs actual +40.0/+32.7/+18.0). ROOT CAUSE of the open miss is a SEPARATE missing structure -- the reduced network never congests: the priced PJM_external node is a single price hub wired to 5 of 8 zones with ~30 GW of uncongested transfer (4.9-7.5 GW each) and the internal TTCs (3-8 GW) are loose, so even a real $0.47-0.87/MMBtu dear-east/cheap-west gas spread (~$3-6/MWh at the burner tip) makes NO link bind and every zone's energy-balance dual ties to one price. The zonal gas structure is correct and stays in (it will separate the LMP once the network congests); the NEXT lever tightens the PJM TTCs / reworks the external star node (verify vs PJM Data Miner interface binding frequency) to close the under-pricing / over-export / gas-CC-over misses. C6 PASS (measured EIA basis, no residual fit, exogenous historic outages). Years 2023-25, single-process sequential solve.
